The skin appears smooth with a slight sheen, suggesting ripeness. Some figs show minor surface imperfections or natural variations in color. The background is out of focus, emphasizing the fruit in the foreground.

artifact_observations.location: Foreground figs, specifically the lower-left and center-bottom fruits
artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture on the closest figs appears slightly overly smooth and uniform, lacking the minute pore-like details (lenticels) often visible on real fig skin under macro inspection. It borders on a 'waxy' AI-smoothness, though not definitively erroneous.

Several figs in the deeper background appear to merge into each other or the background shadow without clear boundary separation. The stems on some background figs seem to dissolve into the fruit body rather than attaching distinctly, a common AI generation issue with repetitive small objects.

The edge of the surface the figs are resting on has a slight inconsistency in straightness and perspective alignment, appearing to warp slightly near the bottom left corner, though this could also be lens distortion.
